name: com.dwjordan.psysonic
description: Psysonic control for Elgato Stream Deck with live album art.

scripts.build: npm run render-icons && npm run icons && rollup -c
scripts.render-icons: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos11 -framework AppKit mac/render-icons.swift -o /tmp/psysonic-ri-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos11 -framework AppKit mac/render-icons.swift -o /tmp/psysonic-ri-x86 && lipo -create -output com.dwjordan.psysonic.sdPlugin/bin/render-icons /tmp/psysonic-ri-arm64 /tmp/psysonic-ri-x86 && chmod +x com.dwjordan.psysonic.sdPlugin/bin/render-icons

author: Dave Jordan
